theme_system.script_placement: index.html inline script to prevent white flash on load

description: Fast, modern e-commerce game marketplace with dual Customer UI and Admin UI featuring full Light/Dark mode support.

styles.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-50
styles.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100

styles.tiny: text-xs font-medium tracking-wide uppercase text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500

typography.instructions: Use .js files (not .tsx). Import Outfit and Manrope in index.css. Avoid Inter for headings.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/40 dark:border-slate-800/50

bottom_navigation.style: fixed bottom-0 w-full z-50 bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-lg border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-safe pt-2 px-6 flex justify-between items-center shadow-[0_-4px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] dark:shadow-[0_-4px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]

layouts.spacing: Use generous padding. p-6 for main cards, gap-6 for major sections.

motion.page_transitions: framer-motion for page entrances (fade in, slight upward translate).
motion.micro_interactions: Scale button to 0.97 on active/tap. Hover states must change background or border color smoothly.
motion.cart_drawer: Slide in from right (desktop) or bottom (mobile) with backdrop blur overlay.

theme_toggle.description: Visible theme switcher button (Sun/Moon icon) present in customer header and admin layout header. Toggles light/dark/system mode using next-themes standard hook useTheme(). MUST have data-testid="theme-toggle-button".

hero.description: Energetic overlay with PUBG yellow highlights. High contrast text visible in both themes.

product_card.description: Surface background (bg-white dark:bg-slate-900), rounded-2xl, subtle shadow. High contrast text.

admin_dashboard.description: Admin UI using table components and metric cards. Fully dark-mode responsive using dark: classes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React components with .js files (NOT .tsx).
Include "data-testid" on all interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, theme toggles).
Place theme toggle switch visible in both customer Header and Admin layout header.
Use next-themes ThemeProvider with attribute="class" to toggle the "dark" class on <html>.
Include anti-flash script in index.html or use next-themes inline injection to prevent white flash on load.
Persist preference with localStorage automatically handled by next-themes.
Do NOT redesign the whole UI, modify existing admin indicators, stock, toasts, payments, Render, MongoDB connection, DNS.
Ensure all existing pages/components remain readable in both themes with appropriate dark: contrast classes.
Never use complete transparent backgrounds for headers, dropdowns, overlays - use backdrop-blur and opaque/glass backgrounds.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast passes WCAG AA in both Light and Dark mode.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 on all inputs and buttons.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
NEVER center align the App container.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
Ensure readable text contrast on dark mode background (dark:bg-slate-950 / dark:bg-slate-900).
